## Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, public, live on publish.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On the policy list (review export, October 2026). Exact wording, so fine. |
| The finest organic loose leaf | **"finest"** is an unprovable superlative and is banned in policy section 3. Remove it. |
| eco-friendly bags | **"eco-friendly"** as a general claim is banned. The policy only supports "plastic-free and home compostable" (EN 13432). |
| packed by hand in Bristol | On the list as "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol". The draft's sentence structure could imply the bags are hand-packed too, so I tightened it to tins. |
| organic | Supported as "Certified organic by the Soil Association". I used the full wording so the claim is traceable. |

**Regulated claims:** the environmental wording is the only risk, and it is fixed below. There are no health, price or urgency claims.

**House style:** no banned words and no obvious AI tells. "Finest" is off-voice for "warm, plain, unhurried", and the fix helps. Score is roughly 75 before and 92 after.

**Disclosure:** nothing needed. This is the brand's own page, with no partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelled content.

**Fixed (suggested copy):**
> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic by the Soil Association loose leaf tea and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags. Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol.

Changes:
- Removed "finest".
- Replaced "eco-friendly bags" with "plastic-free, home compostable tea bags".
- Used the policy's certified-organic wording.
- Tied "packed by hand" to tins.

**Needs a decision:** none, apart from confirming the revised copy.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval. Sam needs to say yes to the revised text above, and the draft as submitted should not go out.
